nodes.name: Read previous state
nodes.notes: Absent on the very first run. onError continues, and alwaysOutputData guarantees an item still flows — without it the node emits zero items, every downstream node is skipped, and n8n still reports the run as successful.

nodes.name: Open a ticket
nodes.notes: Needs a GitHub credential and a real OWNER/REPO. Disabled so the workflow runs end-to-end without one.

nodes.name: Close the ticket — recovered
nodes.notes: Same credential as 'Open a ticket'. Disabled by default.

nodes.name: Parse state file
nodes.notes: Binary buffers are not passed into the JS task runner, so the Code node cannot read them. Converting to json here keeps all binary handling in dedicated nodes.
